title: Moylan and Umeh among new faces for Ireland's Murcia camp
desc: Heimir Hallgrimsson has included Lincoln City attacking midfielder Jack Moylan and Benfica teenager Jaden Umeh among nine uncapped players in his Republic of Ireland squad for the upcoming training camp and friendly in Murcia.

title: WhatsApp is canning avatars just three years after introducing them
desc: Only three years after they were first launched, WhatsApp's avatars are being given the boot, and the messenger service says these digital versions of users will soon no longer be editable and be removed for anyone using one as a profile photo. New avatars can no longer be created either, Meta says on the WhatsApp help pages.
